single.rationale: Prime Medicine is a pre-revenue gene editing biotechnology company with substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern. With only $177.7M cash against ~$167M annual cash burn and no product revenue expected for years, the company faces imminent financing needs. While the technology platform and pipeline (Wilson Disease, AATD) have potential, the financial risk overwhelms investment appeal at this stage.
